title: Monotonicity of composed majority
statement: For every integer $m\ge 0$, the composed majority function on the sign cube of dimension $2+(2m+1)$ is monotone: if $x_i\le y_i$ in every coordinate, then its value at $x$ is at most its value at $y$, where $-1<1$.
